expectation: LAG3 is a membrane/surface marker on a minority of activated or exhausted T cells and some NK cells. Expect rare, scattered single cells or small clusters with ring-like signal, mainly in lymphoid or T-cell-rich areas. It should not be uniform.
observed: A: many panels are covered in fine yellow grain. Two panels are almost uniformly yellow, and some panels have a few bright dots. B and C: scattered single-pixel specks across tissue and background, not tied to the nuclei. D: the brightest spot is a small blob inside general haze.
why: The signal is diffuse grain and speckle that follows tissue texture and varies by panel, with no distinct population of cells.
notes: Yellow signal is fine grain over tissue and background. Two panels are uniformly yellow. B and C show specks not tied to nuclei, and the D hotspot is a lone blob in haze. No convincing positive cell subset.
